title: JSONPath lab
description: Write JSONPath expressions against a JSON document, see what each one selects highlighted in the document, and fix them.
needs: an object with paths ([{ id, path, expectedCount (-1 for none) }], at least one) and a document (any JSON)

tools.name: addPath
tools.description: Add a JSONPath expression; it gets the next free id (p1, p2, …).

tools.name: reorderPaths
tools.description: Move a path to a position (0 is first).

tools.name: setExpectedCount
tools.description: Say how many results a path should give, or -1 for no expectation.

tools.name: setDocument
tools.description: Replace the JSON document the paths run against.

tools.name: results
tools.description: What a path selects: its count, its expected count if any, and each result's JSON Pointer and value (at most 200).

tools.name: documentPaths
tools.description: The document's nodes as JSON Pointers with their types (at most 200), to learn its shape.
